name: fonts
title: Self-hosted fonts
summary: Replace the Google Fonts link with @fontsource packages: same-origin, no third-party request, only the subsets and weights you use.
when: Before launch, once the font pairing is final. Faster first paint, no visitor IPs sent to Google (a GDPR issue in the EU), simpler CSP.
next: Run npm run fonts:self-host -- "<Family>:<weights>" for each family in tailwind.config.ts fontFamily, e.g. "Inter:400,500,600" "Sora:600,700".
